title: SOC orientation: what you’re protecting
summary: What a SIEM team’s resources are for, then 7 questions every SOC needs its own answers to — not looked up, worked out.

atoms.title: What these resources are for
atoms.body:
These resources are intended to guide a SIEM team to...

- ... develop a workflow for content creation (and retirement) in the SIEM and other security tools.
- ... illustrate detection coverage provided and highlight coverage gaps as goals to fill.
- ... eliminate or add additional layers of coverage based on organizational needs.
- Ensure proper logs are generated and recorded for sufficient detection, investigation, and compliance.

atoms.title: Crown jewels: think before you look
atoms.body: No single right answer — work this out against your own environment, not the source text.

payload.prompt: What is the most sensitive data and where is it stored?
payload.reveal: This question is intentionally open-ended — the source names it as something a SOC team identifies for itself, not a fact to memorize. There is no canonical answer here; the point is to have actually tried answering it against a real environment before moving on.
